blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Highly compressed video autoencoders offer an effective way to accelerate video diffusion models, since the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) then operates on far fewer tokens. However, such autoencoders are difficult to obtain: a higher compression ratio degrades reconstruction quality, and recovering it requires more latent channels, which is known to slow DiT convergence. Moreover, the compressed latent space differs from the one the DiT was trained on, so the pretrained DiT must either be retrained from scratch or adapted at considerable cost. Further compressing the autoencoder that the DiT was trained with may seem to preserve compatibility, yet optimizing it for reconstruction alone still shifts the latent away from the distribution the DiT has learned. To address this, we propose Generation-Aware Latent Compression for Efficient Video Generation (GRACE) , a two-stage framework that compresses a pretrained video autoencoder while keeping it compatible with the pretrained DiT. In the first stage, we retain the base latent produced by the frozen pretrained encoder and learn a residual latent that captures the information lost under stronger compression. We further align the compressed latent with the pretrained latent in the feature space of the frozen DiT, so that the autoencoder is optimized for generation rather than reconstruction alone. In the second stage, we adapt the DiT through lightweight fine-tuning and asymmetric denoising, in which the base latent is denoised ahead of the residual latent. GRACE reduces the token count of Wan2.1-I2V-14B by nearly 𝟖 × 8\times and its latency by 11.1 × 11.1\times at 480 × 832 480{\times}832 resolution with 81 frames, while matching the VBench generation quality of the pretrained pipeline before compression.
blocks.zh: 高度压缩的视频自编码器为加速视频传播模型提供了有效的方式,因为再由分解变形器(DIT)在更少的代号上运行. 然而,这种自定义编码器很难获得:更高的压缩比会降低重建质量,恢复它需要更隐蔽的通道,众所周知这会减缓DiT的收缩. 此外,压缩后的潜在空间与DiT所训练的空间不同,因此预先训练的DiT要么必须从零开始再训练,要么以相当高的成本进行改造. 进一步压缩DiT所训练的自动编码器可能似乎保持了相容性,但仅用于重建的优化仍然转移了DiT所学到的分布的潜伏. 为了解决这个问题,我们提出“一代-智能Laten Conpression for effective Video Crowth”(GRACE),这是一个两阶段框架,它压缩一个预先训练的视频自动编码器,同时保持它与预先训练的DiT兼容. 在第一阶段,我们保留了由被冷冻的预装编码器产生的底物,并学会了一种能捕捉到在更强的压缩下所丢失的信息的残余潜质. 我们进一步将压缩后潜与被冷冻的DiT的地物空间中预受训练后潜合为一,这样自动编码器就能够被优化用于生成,而不只是重建. 在第二阶段,我们通过轻量级微调和不对称去诺化来调整DiT,其中底部潜伏被去诺化后先于残余潜伏. GRACE将Wan2.1-I2V-14B的活字计数减少近8×8×8×8×8×8×8×8×8×8×8×8×2×832分辨率为81帧,同时在压缩前将预装管的V Bench生成质量相匹配.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances in video diffusion models ( Wan et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2025 ; HaCohen et al., 2024 ) have demonstrated remarkable generation quality, yet their computational cost remains a significant bottleneck for both training and inference. This computational cost largely depends on the number of tokens processed by the Diffusion Transformer (DiT) ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) , whose attention scales quadratically with sequence length.
blocks.zh: 视频传播模型的最新进展(Wan等人,2025年;Ma等人,2025年;HaCohen等人,2024年)显示出显著的生成质量,但其计算成本仍然是培训和推论方面的一个重大瓶颈。 这种计算成本很大程度上取决于被"分化变形器"(DIT)(Peebles and Xie, 2023)处理的符号数量,其注意力以序列长度为四倍.

blocks.en: The number of input tokens scales with the spatio-temporal resolution of the latent produced by the video autoencoder ( Wan et al., 2025 ; HaCohen et al., 2024 ) . Therefore, increasing the autoencoder compression ratio provides a straightforward way to reduce computation. However, fewer tokens limit the representational capacity of the latent, leading to a significant drop in reconstruction quality ( Yao et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 输入符的数量与视频自动编码器产生的潜伏物的时空分辨率相比(Wan等,2025;HaCohen等,2024)。 因此,增加自动编码器压缩比为减少计算提供了直接的方法. 然而,代号较少限制了潜在者的代表能力,导致重建质量大幅下降(姚等,2025年)。

blocks.en: To preserve reconstruction quality with fewer tokens, previous works ( Chen et al., 2025a ; Chen et al., 2025c ; HaCohen et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2025 ) increase the channel dimension of each token. However, higher-dimensional latents are known to compromise generation quality, introducing a trade-off between reconstruction and generation quality ( Yao et al., 2025 ) , and they converge more slowly, raising the training cost. Moreover, modifying the autoencoder architecture typically requires retraining the autoencoder from scratch, making it difficult to fully leverage pretrained knowledge and incurring substantial training cost. Reusing a released high-compression autoencoder avoids such cost but passes the burden to the pretrained DiT, which must adapt to a latent space never seen during pretraining and may not fully converge even on 160 GPUs ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . A natural alternative is to leverage a pretrained autoencoder by adding a lightweight compression block to its architecture. However, we empirically find that this approach still degrades generation quality (Tabs. 1 and 4 ). Optimizing the autoencoder and the additional compression block solely for reconstruction shifts the resulting latent distribution away from that learned by the pretrained DiT, degrading generation quality ( He et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 以较少的代币保持重建质量,以前的作品(Chen等,2025a; Chen等,2025c;HaCohen等,2024;Zheng等,2026;Ma等,2025)增加每个信使的通道尺寸. 然而,人们知道,更高维度的潜想会损害发电质量,在重建质量和发电质量之间带来取舍(姚等,2025年),这些潜想更缓慢地汇合在一起,提高了培训成本. 此外,修改自动编码器架构通常需要从头对自动编码器进行再培训,因此难以充分利用预先培训过的知识并产生大量培训费用。 重用放出的高压自编码器可以避免这种成本,但将负担转移给预先训练的DiT,它必须适应在预训期间从未见过的潜在空间,甚至可能无法完全在160个GPU上聚合(Zheng等,2026年). 一个自然的替代品是通过在它的架构中添加一个轻量级压缩块来利用一个被预先训练的自编码器. 然而,我们从经验中发现,这种做法仍然会降低发电质量(第1和4段)。 优化自动编码器和仅用于重建的额外压缩块,使由此产生的潜在分布脱离了经过预先训练的DiT所学到的,降低了生成质量(He等,2026;Zhao等,2024)。

blocks.en: These observations point to two key challenges in efficient latent compression: (1) efficiently adapting pretrained autoencoder and DiT models while fully leveraging their pretrained knowledge, and (2) reducing the gap between reconstruction and generation quality introduced by compression. Our key insight is that a pretrained autoencoder and DiT already form a well-aligned generative pipeline, and this alignment can be exploited during compression. We therefore propose Generation-Aware Latent Compression for Efficient Video Generation (GRACE) , a training framework that compresses a pretrained video autoencoder while explicitly accounting for both reconstruction and generation quality.
blocks.zh: 这些观测指出,在高效的潜在压缩方面有两个关键的挑战:(1) 高效地调整预先训练的自编码器和DiT模型,同时充分利用其预先训练的知识;和(2) 缩小压缩带来的重建与生成质量之间的差距. 我们的关键见解是,一个预先训练的自编码器和DiT已经形成了一个紧密相通的基因管,这种对接可以在压缩时被利用. 因此,我们提议为高效视频生成而采用一代-智能Lateent Conpression(GRACE),这是一个培训框架,压缩一个经过预先培训的视频自动编码器,同时明确兼顾重建和生成质量。

blocks.en: First, to fully leverage the pretrained autoencoder, we introduce a dual-latent representation that separates the pretrained representation from the information lost to compression. The base latent is obtained from the pretrained autoencoder using a spatially and temporally downsampled input, preserving the representation already learned by the pretrained autoencoder. The residual latent then captures the spatial detail and inter-frame motion that the low-resolution base latent cannot represent. This design allows the compressed autoencoder to retain the pretrained representation while using the residual latent only to complement what the downsampled input leaves out.
blocks.zh: 首先,为了充分利用预先训练的自编码器,我们引入了一种双相代表,将预先训练的能代表与被压缩所损失的信息分开. 底潜取自预先训练的自编码器,使用空间和时间上下取样输入,保留预先训练的自编码器已经学到的能见度。 然后,残余的潜在物捕捉出低分辨率底物所不能代表的空间细节和相框运动。 这种设计使得被压缩的自编码器能够保留被事先训练过的表示,同时使用剩余潜伏物只能补充被下取样的输入所遗漏的东西.

blocks.en: Second, we introduce asymmetric denoising to exploit this separation during generation. The base latent is denoised at an earlier timestep than the residual latent, allowing the denoised base to provide a stable anchor for the residual to recover the missing information. Both latents are denoised within a single pass, introducing no additional sampling cost.
blocks.zh: 第二,我们引入不对称的去诺来利用这种世代分化. 碱基潜出的时间比残余潜出的时间要早,使被溶出的物质能为残余物提供稳定的锚地来取回所缺失的信息. 两种潜伏物在一次通行证内被取消,不增加取样费用。

blocks.en: Finally, to preserve compatibility with the pretrained DiT, we introduce generation-aware alignment, which matches the compressed autoencoder latent with the pretrained latent in the DiT’s feature space. Rather than relying solely on conventional reconstruction objectives such as L1/L2 and perceptual losses ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) , we use intermediate DiT features to measure the distance between the compressed and pretrained latents. This generation-aware alignment encourages the compressed latent to remain compatible with the distribution learned by the pretrained DiT, thereby reducing the gap between reconstruction and generation quality.
blocks.zh: 最后,为了保持与预先训练的DiT的相容性,我们引入了生成-意识对接,该对接将压缩的自编码器潜入到DiT特性空间中预先训练的潜入相匹配. 我们不只依靠L1/L2等传统重建目标和感知损失(张等,2018年),而是使用中间DiT特性来测量被压缩和被预先训练的潜伏体之间的距离. 这种世代意识的相接鼓励压缩后潜能与被预先训练的DiT所学到的分布保持相容,从而缩小了重建与生成质量之间的差距.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Latent compression for efficient video generation. Video diffusion models are computationally expensive since they repeatedly denoise a large number of latent tokens. Existing acceleration methods either reduce the number of denoising steps ( Song et al., 2022 ; Lu et al., 2022 ; Zhao et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Li et al., 2024 ) , often at the cost of quality, or reduce the computation per step ( Xi et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ) . Several works ( HaCohen et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Tian et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025b ; Ma et al., 2025 ) instead propose to compress the latent beyond the common setting of 8 × 8\times spatial and 4 × 4\times temporal compression (f8t4), which significantly lowers the token count by a fixed ratio. Existing approaches increase spatial compression through autoencoder architectural changes ( Chen et al., 2025a ; Tian et al., 2025 ) , or progressively increase temporal compression ( Mahapatra et al., 2025 ) . A complementary strategy assigns more channels to each token to preserve reconstruction quality at high compression ratios, but wider latents can degrade generation quality, which recent work addresses by structuring the channel dimension ( Chen et al., 2025c ; Cai et al., 2026 ) . Our work compresses the video autoencoder in both space and time by fine-tuning a pretrained autoencoder and DiT rather than training either from scratch, keeping training cost low while mainly addressing the generation quality and convergence issues introduced by increased channel capacity.
blocks.zh: 用于高效视频生成的Latet压缩. 视频传播模型在计算上成本很高,因为这些模型多次使大量潜在的信物暴露出. 现有的加速度方法或者减少去诺步骤的数量(宋等,2022;吕等,2022;赵等,2023;王等,2024;李等,2024;常以质量为代价),或者减少每步骤的计算(习近平等,2025;孙等,2025.). 有多部作品(HaCohen等,2024;Zheng等,2026;Tian等,2025;Chen等,2025b;Ma等,2025)提议将潜伏量压缩到8×8正时空间和4×4正时时间压缩(f8t4)共同设定之外,这显著地将象征量降低到固定比例. 现有方法通过自动编码器的建筑变化来增加空间压缩(Chen等,2025a; Tian等,2025年),或逐渐增加时间压缩(Mahapatra等,2025年). 一项补充战略为每个标志分配了更多的渠道,以保持高压缩率的重建质量,但更广泛的潜在因素会降低发电质量,最近的工作通过安排信道的尺寸来解决这个问题(Chen等,2025c;Cai等,2026)。 我们的工作通过精细调整预先训练的自动编码器和DiT,而不是从零开始训练,在空间和时间上压缩视频自动编码器,使培训费用保持在低水平,同时主要解决通过提高频道容量带来的生成质量和趋同问题。

blocks.en: Autoencoder adaptation for pretrained generators. A few recent works redesign or improve the autoencoder in generation pipelines ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025c ; Cai et al., 2026 ) . One line of work regularizes the latent with a pretrained vision foundation model so that a diffusion model learns it more easily ( Yao et al., 2025 ) , but trains both the autoencoder and the generator from scratch. Changing the latent space in this way typically requires retraining the DiT from scratch at prohibitive cost, since the new latent distribution no longer matches the one on which the DiT was trained. To avoid this cost, other works reuse the pretrained DiT and close the resulting mismatch during training ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . Some constrain the new latent to remain reconstructable by the pretrained decoder ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) , while others align patch embeddings between the pretrained and modified pipelines after the latent space has already diverged ( He et al., 2026 ) . We instead optimize the autoencoder latent with intermediate features from the frozen DiT, keeping it close to the representation space where the pretrained generator operates.

blocks.en: We propose GRACE , a two-stage framework that compresses the latent of a pretrained pipeline while preserving generation quality (Fig. 2 ). Stage 1 fine-tunes the autoencoder into a dual latent of a frozen base and a learned residual, guided by the frozen DiT (Section 4.2 ). Stage 2 adapts the DiT to that latent, denoising the base ahead of the residual (Section 4.3 ). In both stages, the pretrained pipeline before compression guides its own compression.

Generation-aware alignment in pretrained DiT feature space. The dual-latent representation alone narrows the gap between the compressed latent and the pretrained latent space, but we find it insufficient at higher compression ratios, where the residual latent must carry more information missing from the base. The residual channels are optimized only through the reconstruction objective, which improves fidelity but does not directly account for how easily the diffusion model can learn the resulting latent. We introduce generation-aware alignment, a regularizer that supervises the compressed latent inside the feature space of the pretrained DiT without modifying the autoencoder architecture. Our approach builds on the same insight as prior autoencoder adaptation methods: reconstruction fidelity alone does not necessarily yield a compressed latent that the diffusion backbone can learn effectively ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025c ) .
Since the pretrained DiT is already adapted to the original latent space, we compare the two latents in its intermediate feature space. blocks.en: In this section, we adapt the pretrained DiT to the compressed latent while keeping the autoencoder frozen. Since the compressed latent adds C ′ C^{\prime} unseen channels, we extend the DiT input and output projections from C C to C + C ′ C+C^{\prime} channels. We fully fine-tune these projections and apply LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) to the transformer blocks, keeping the adaptation cost low while preserving the pretrained generation capability ( He et al., 2026 ) . The DiT is trained with the flow matching loss ℒ velocity \mathcal{L}_{\text{velocity}} , applied to the base and the residual latent at different noise levels, which we describe next.
blocks.zh: 在这一节中,我们调整了预先训练的DiT以适应被压缩的潜伏,同时保持自定义编码器被冻结. 由于压缩潜伏增加了C ' C^{\prime] 隐形通道,我们把DiT输入和输出预测从C到C+C+C^{\prime]通道. 我们充分调整这些预测,并将LORA(Hu等,2021年)应用于变压器块,保持了适应成本低廉,同时保留了预先训练的生成能力(He等,2026年). DiT 被训练为流量匹配损失 L 速度 \ mathcal{ L}_{\text{ 速度} , 应用到底部和不同噪声水平的剩余潜伏, 我们下面描述 。

blocks.en: Asymmetric denoising. Our key idea is to denoise the two parts of the latent asymmetrically, keeping the base ahead of the residual so that the residual builds on a reliable foundation throughout generation. The residual encoder is trained to carry what the base does not, so what the residual should contain becomes clearer as the base settles, which makes the residual easier to generate.

blocks.en: Evaluation details. We evaluate reconstruction on Panda-70M ( Chen et al., 2024 ) with PSNR, SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) , LPIPS ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) , and rFVD ( Unterthiner et al., 2019 ) , and generation on VBench-I2V ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) . We compare against publicly released video autoencoders that compress more aggressively than Wan2.1-VAE, with the pretrained pipeline before compression as the reference. The compared autoencoders are trained independently of Wan2.1-VAE, whereas our single-latent baseline and GRACE-VAE are fine-tuned from it. To measure generation, we adapt the pretrained Wan2.1-I2V-14B to every latent under the same total budget of 38.5 H200 GPU days. The compared latents spend the whole budget on DiT adaptation, while our pipeline spends 8.5 days on the autoencoder and 30 on the DiT. Our adaptation builds on the frozen Wan2.1 base latent, which is unavailable to the compared autoencoders, so we instead transfer them with the released implementation of DC-Gen ( He et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025b ) , which is designed to adapt a pretrained DiT to a new latent space (see Appendix C.1 for the adaptation details).
blocks.zh: 评价细节。 我们评价了熊猫-70M(陈等,2024年)与PSNR,SSIM(王等,2004年),LPIPS(张等,2018年)和rFVD(Unterthiner等,2019年)的重建,并评价了V Bench-I2V(黄等,2023年;黄等,2024年)的生成. 我们比较了公开发布的比Wan2.1-VAE更猛烈压缩的视频自定义编码器,而压缩前预先训练的管道作为参考. 比较的自编码器是独立于Wan2.1-VAE培训的,而我们的单相基线和GRACE-VAE则从中微调出. 为了测量生成量,我们在38.5个H200 GPU日的总预算下,将预先训练过的Wan2.1-I2V-14B适应了每一个潜伏. 相比而言,潜在因素将整个预算用于DiT的适应,而我们的管道则花费8.5天用于自动编码器,30天用于DiT. 我们的适应以被冻结的Wan2.1基潜在为基础,比较的自编码器无法使用,因此我们用DC-Gen(He等人,2026年;Chen等人,2025年b)的释放执行来转移这些基潜在,该基潜在设计是为了使预先训练的DIT适应一个新的潜在空间(适应细节见附录C.1)。

blocks.en: Main results. As shown in Tab. 1 , better reconstruction does not mean better generation. Step-Video-VAE reconstructs 1.91 dB above LTX-VAE but scores 3.01 lower on VBench-I2V, even at 4 × 4\times the tokens, and our single-latent baseline reconstructs 1.13 dB above GRACE-VAE yet scores 1.46 lower. GRACE-VAE reaches the highest generation quality among the compressed autoencoders at the smallest token count, within 0.02 of the pretrained pipeline, while Video DC-AE and Step-Video-VAE use 2 × 2\times and 4 × 4\times more tokens yet score 2.98 and 3.87 lower than the pretrained pipeline.
blocks.zh: 主要结果。 如图一所示,更好的重建并不意味着更好的一代。 步骤视频-VAE重建 超过LTX-VAE的1.91分B,但比V Bench-I2V低出3.01分,甚至4×4分之多,我们的单相基准重建 1.13分B高于GRACE-VAE,但得分却低于1.46分. GRACE-VAE在压缩自编码器中达到最高的生成质量,最小的符号计数,在预试管线的0.02以内;而Video DC-AE和Step-Video-VAE则使用2×2\times和4×4\times的比预试管线的比分更低的2.98分和3.87分.

blocks.en: 5.3 Video Generation Results
blocks.zh: 5.3 视频生成结果

blocks.en: Evaluation details. We evaluate on VBench ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) for both I2V and T2V at 480 × 832 × 81 480{\times}832{\times}81 with 50 sampling steps, generating one video per prompt over the full benchmark, and measure latency on a single A100 GPU. The models built on Wan2.1-14B share the same pretrained DiT, while LTX-Video and Open-Sora 2.0 use their own generators, which differ from Wan2.1-14B in model size and training data. Both also run a third guidance branch, which raises the forward passes per video to 150.
blocks.zh: 评价细节。 我们以480×832×81 480×832}}}832×时}81对I2V和T2V的V Bench(Huang等,2023;Huang等,2024)进行评价,并有50个采样步骤,每快取出一盘视频,超过全部基准,在单A100 GPU上测量耐用性. 在Wan2.1-14B上所建的型号共享相同的预训DiT,而LTX-Video和Open-Sora 2.0则使用自己的发电机,在模型尺寸和培训数据上与Wan2.1-14B不同. 两人还开设了第三个指导分会,将每部视频的前进通行证提高到150个.

blocks.en: Main results. As shown in Tab. 2 , GRACE stays within 0.02 of the pretrained pipeline before compression on I2V and exceeds it on T2V, while running 11.1 × 11.1\times faster. The T2V gain comes mostly from the semantic score, where GRACE leads the next best model by 5.28. The ablation in Tab. 4 traces this gain to both stages: the dual latent alone keeps the semantic score at the pretrained level, and generation-aware alignment and the base-ahead offset raise it by 3.90 and 2.43. At 736 × 1280 × 81 736{\times}1280{\times}81 (Tab. 3 ), GRACE again reaches the highest T2V total at the lowest latency and stays within 0.04 of the pretrained pipeline on I2V while running 15.5 × 15.5\times faster.
blocks.zh: 主要结果。 如塔布所显示. 2,GRACE在I2V上压缩前停留在预装管线的0.02以内并超过T2V,同时运行速度更快. 11.1×11.1\时. T2V增益多出自语义分数,其中GRACE以5.28领先下一位最佳模型. 塔布的废墟。 4 将这一收益追溯到两个阶段:双潜将语义分数维持在预训水平上,而生成意识相接和基头相抵则提高3.90和2.43. 在736×1280×81 736}1280⁄times}81(Tab. 3)时,GRACE再次以最低纬度达到T2V的总和并停留在I2V上预训管的0.04以内,同时运行速度更快地达到15.5×15.5\分.

blocks.en: Quantitative comparison. In Tabs. 2 and 3 , the most direct comparison is DC-Gen, which adapts the same pretrained DiT at twice our token count. GRACE runs faster than DC-Gen and scores higher on every VBench total, although DC-Gen is higher on the quality scores at 736 × 1280 × 81 736{\times}1280{\times}81 , which we examine in the qualitative comparison below. GRACE also follows the conditioning image more closely, leading DC-Gen on the I2V score by 7.23 at 480 × 832 × 81 480{\times}832{\times}81 . LTX-Video reaches a higher I2V total at the same token count but runs slower, since a third guidance branch adds a DiT pass per step. On T2V, however, LTX-Video scores 6.64 below GRACE at 480 × 832 × 81 480{\times}832{\times}81 . Open-Sora 2.0 uses about twice our token count, yet runs slower and has the lowest VBench totals in both tasks at both resolutions. In text-to-video, GRACE leads on background consistency and temporal flickering at both resolutions, despite moving more than the pretrained pipeline. Appendix D.2 reports a human evaluation against Wan2.1-14B and DC-Gen.

GRACE还更紧密地跟随了调制图像,在480×832×81相480相832相81相832相81相,带领DC-Gen在I2V分数上以7.23分领先. LTX-Video在同一同位数上达到更高的I2V总分,但跑得更慢,因为第三导行每步会增加一个DiT通. 然而在T2V上,LTX-Video在GRACE下以480×832×81 480×times}832×times}81的分数为6.64分. Open-Sora 2. 0使用大约两倍于我们符号的计数,然而运行速度较慢,在两项决议中的V Bench总和都最低. 在从文本到视频中,GRACE在背景一致性和时间闪烁两个决议方面都领先,尽管进展超过预先训练的管道。 附录D.2报告了对Wan2.1-14B和DC-Gen进行的人类评价。

blocks.en: Qualitative comparison. Figs. 5 and 6 compare GRACE with the pretrained pipeline. GRACE preserves the scene layout, the subject, and the motion of the pretrained samples while using nearly 8 × 8\times fewer tokens. DC-Gen, by contrast, departs from the pretrained pipeline, producing samples that move more and are consistently more saturated (Figs. I.1 – I.4 ). These differences raise the quality scores of DC-Gen at 736 × 1280 × 81 736{\times}1280{\times}81 , since the LAION aesthetic predictor used by VBench scores saturated images higher ( Schuhmann et al., 2022 ; Taylor et al., 2026 ) . LTX-Video falls short in a different way, often missing the action described in the prompt. In the human action dimension of VBench-T2V, LTX-Video scores 86.00 at both resolutions, against 96.00–100.00 for every other model, including 99.00 and 100.00 for GRACE (Tabs. D.1 and D.2 ). At 736 × 1280 × 81 736{\times}1280{\times}81 in image-to-video, the motion of LTX-Video tends to come from a global zoom or a slow camera movement over the conditioning image, while the scene stays static (Figs. I.7 – I.9 ). GRACE instead stays close to the color and style of the pretrained pipeline.
blocks.zh: 质相相相. 图5和图6将GRACE与经过预先训练的管道进行比较. GRACE保留了场景布局,主题,以及预训样品的运动,同时使用近8×8\times更少的活字. 相比之下,DC-Gen则脱离了经过预先训练的管线,生产出运动得更强并持续地更饱和的样品(图一.1—一.4 ). 这些差异将DC-Gen的质量分数提升到736×1280×81 736\times}1280\times}81,因为V Bench使用的LAION美学预测器的分数是饱和图像更高的(Shuhmann等,2022;Taylor等,2026). LTX-Video以不同的方式出现不足,常常错过了即时描述的动作. 在V Bench-T2V的人类行动方面,LTX-Video在两个分辨率上都得分86.00分,而其他模型则得分96.00-100.00分,包括GRACE的99.00分和100.00分(Tabs. D.1和D.2. ). 在736×1280×81 736{\times}1280{\times}81分,LTX-Video的运动往往来自全球放大器或固定图像上缓慢相机运动,而场景则保持不变(图一.7-一.9 ). 而GRACE则保持了与预训管的颜色和风格相近.

blocks.en: 5.4 Training Cost and Convergence
blocks.zh: 5.4 培训费用和配合

blocks.en: Figure 7: Convergence during DiT adaptation. With and without ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\text{align}} ; solid lines show EMA.
blocks.zh: 图7:DiT适应过程中的趋同. 用和不用 L 对齐\ mathcal{L}_{\text{ align};固行显示EMA.

blocks.en:
Most of the training cost lies in adapting the DiT to the compressed latent.
Reusing the pretrained DiT reduces this cost substantially, since a DiT trained from scratch for the same number of steps falls far behind on both VBench-T2V and VBench-I2V (Tab. 4 , rows II and III).
Reuse alone is not sufficient, however, as Open-Sora 2.0 reports blurry videos that do not fully converge even on 160 GPUs after adapting a pretrained DiT to Video DC-AE, an autoencoder trained from scratch ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) .
Under the same budget, both the Video DC-AE latent and our single-latent baseline fall short of the pretrained pipeline, although the latter is fine-tuned from the pretrained autoencoder with ℒ recon \mathcal{L}_{\text{recon}} (Tab. 1 ).
The adaptation cost thus appears to depend on how easily the pretrained DiT can learn the latent, which ℒ recon \mathcal{L}_{\text{recon}} alone does not account for.
Adding ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\text{align}} makes the residual converge faster to a lower flow matching loss (Fig. 7 ), while the base channels behave almost identically, since the DiT already models the base latent space.
As a result, GRACE matches the pretrained pipeline with 8.5 H200 GPU days for the autoencoder and 30 for the DiT.
blocks.zh:
大部分培训费用在于使DiT适应被压缩的潜在。
重新使用事先训练过的DiT可大幅降低这一成本,因为从头开始训练的DiT在V Bench-T2V和V Bench-I2V(第4行,第二行和第三行)上都远远落后。
但光是重复使用是不够的, Open-Sora 2.0 报告模糊的视频, 连160 GPU都没有完全聚合,
在同一预算下,视频DC-AE潜伏线和我们的单一线性基线都未达到经过预先训练的管道,尽管后者从经过预先训练的自动编码器中微调出L spea-mathcal{L}_{\text{recon}} (Tab. 1).
因此,适应成本似乎取决于预先训练的DiT如何容易地学习潜伏,而L second { mathcal{L}_{\text{recon}}}本身并不能说明这一点。
添加 & mathcal{L}_{\text{ align} 可使剩余相接速度更快地汇合到更低的流量匹配损失(图 7) , 而基道行为几乎完全相同, 因为 DiT 已经模拟了基底潜在空间 。
因此,GRACE将预装管线与自动编码器的8.5个H200GPU天和DiT相匹配.

blocks.en: 5.5 Ablations and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5.5 拖欠款和讨论

blocks.en: Ablation on design components. Each component in Tab. 4 improves generation on both tasks. The dual latent and the offset raise the T2V total by 1.43 and 1.13 but the I2V total by only 0.20 and 0.39, as both determine what the generation is anchored to, whereas I2V already provides the conditioning image as an anchor. The dual latent also makes the alignment possible, since ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\text{align}} needs a pretrained latent to match against. Alignment behaves differently, raising the I2V score as well as both T2V scores, since the conditioning image anchors the content but does not resolve the mismatch between the compressed latent and the DiT’s pretrained denoising space. Alignment therefore recovers most of the gap to the pretrained pipeline on I2V and goes further on T2V, where the total ends up above that pipeline, which may relate to the latent structure that the alignment loss induces (Fig. 3 ).
blocks.zh: 对设计组件的考虑。 标签中的每个组件。 4 改进两项任务的生成。 双重潜伏和相抵使T2V的总数增加了1.43和1.13,但I2V的总数只增加了0.20和0.39,因为两者都决定了这一代人所依靠的是什么,而I2V已经提供了作为锚地的调节图像。 双重潜入也使得对齐成为可能,因为 L 对齐 \ mathcal{L}_{\text{ align} 需要一个预先训练的潜入来匹配 。 校正行为不同,提高了I2V分数以及T2V分数,因为调制图像会锁定内容,但不能解决压缩后潜入和DiT预受训练去诺空间之间的不匹配. 因此,对接恢复了大部分与I2V上经过预先训练的管线的缺口,并更进一步于T2V上,因为T2V的总量会超过该管线,这可能与对接损失引起的潜在结构有关(图3)。

blocks.en: Alignment target. We align the compressed latent inside the pretrained DiT (Section 4.2 ), and Tab. 5 assesses the impact of the alignment target while keeping everything else fixed. Prior work regularizes a high-dimensional latent with a pretrained vision foundation model so that it is easier for a diffusion model to learn ( Yao et al., 2025 ) . For that comparison, we use V-JEPA 2.1 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) , a video foundation model whose dense features are spatially structured and temporally consistent. We keep the loss, the adaptive weighting, and the structure of P l P_{l} , and replace the target with V-JEPA 2.1 features of the clean video, applying P l P_{l} directly to the compressed latent since the target is no longer in the DiT feature space (see Appendix C.3 for the setup). Aligning to V-JEPA 2.1 raises the semantic score from 78.65 to 80.04, while aligning inside the pretrained DiT raises it far higher, to 82.55, with the totals following the same order. These results suggest that vision foundation models provide useful semantic structure in general, but in our setting, the relevant structure is the one already represented by the pretrained DiT, since the compressed autoencoder is adapted to a fixed denoising model.
blocks.zh: 目标对齐 我们把压缩后潜伏在预先训练的DiT(第4.2节)内,Tab. 5评估了校正目标的影响,同时保持其他一切固定. 先前的工作使高维度的潜想规范化,并采用经过预先培训的视觉基础模型,以便推广模型更容易学习(姚等,2025年)。 为了进行这种比较,我们使用了V-JEPA 2.1(Mur-Labadia等,2026年),这是一个视频地基模型,其密集特征在空间结构上和时间上是一致的. 我们保留损失、适应性加权和Pl P_{l}的结构,并将目标取而代之的是清洁视频的V-JEPA 2.1特性,将Pl P_{l}直接应用到被压缩的潜伏中,因为目标已不在DiT特征空间(设置部分见附录C.3). 与V-JEPA 2.1对齐,将语义分数从78.65分提高到了80.04分,同时将预训DiT内部的对齐将分数提高到了远为高的82.55分,总分按同顺序排列. 这些结果表明,视觉基础模型总体上提供了有用的语义结构,但在我们的设定中,相关的结构已经由被预先训练的DiT所代表,因为压缩自编码器被调整为固定去名模型.

blocks.en: Denoising schedule design. Tab. 6 compares the denoising order, used in both DiT adaptation and sampling. Denoising the base first improves the total, while reversing it drops below the synchronous schedule, showing that the direction of the offset is what matters. The gain costs nothing at inference, since both parts are denoised in the same forward pass.
blocks.zh: 德诺瓦辛计划设计. 标签6比较了DiT适应和采样中使用的去名顺序. Denoising the Base首先能改善总和,而倒置则会下降至同步时间表以下,表明抵消的方向才是最重要的. 收益不会花费任何推论,因为这两部分都是在同一个前行中去除的。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We presented GRACE, a framework that compresses the latent of a pretrained video diffusion pipeline and adapts the DiT to the compressed latent. GRACE keeps a frozen base latent and learns a residual latent for the information lost under stronger compression, aligns the compressed latent with the pretrained latent in the feature space of the frozen DiT, and denoises the base ahead of the residual so that the residual builds on a settled base. GRACE matches the VBench generation quality of the pretrained pipeline before compression on Wan2.1-I2V-14B while running 11.1 × 11.1\times faster at 480 × 832 × 81 480{\times}832{\times}81 , and the speedup grows with resolution, reaching 15.5 × 15.5\times at 736 × 1280 × 81 736{\times}1280{\times}81 . Across the compared autoencoders, better reconstruction does not mean better generation. Optimizing the autoencoder for reconstruction alone moves the latent away from the distribution the DiT has learned, which is why GRACE supervises compression in the space the DiT operates in.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了GRACE, 这个框架压缩了 预先训练好的视频传播管道的潜伏性, 并使DiT适应压缩潜伏性。 GRACE保持了被冻结的基体潜伏,为在更强的压缩下丢失的信息学习了剩余基体;使被压缩的基体与被冻结的DiT的地物空间中预先受训练的基体相配合;将基体先于剩余基体,使剩余基体以固定基体为基础。 GRACE在Wan2.1-I2V-14B上压缩前与预训管的V Bench生成质量相匹配,同时以480×832×81 480×832×832×832×85×81等速度更快地运行,速度随分辨率而增长,以736×1280×81 736×1280×120×81等速度达到15.5×15等. 在比较的自动编码器中,更好的重建并不意味着更好的一代。 优化重建的自动编码器将潜伏的离DiT所学到的分布器而去,这就是GRACE监督DiT运行的空间压缩的原因.

blocks.en: This appendix provides supplementary material to support the main paper. • Appendix A describes the architecture and the training setup of our autoencoder, and Appendix B provides the corresponding details for the DiT, including how it is extended to the compressed latent. • Appendix C describes how the compared autoencoders are adapted to the pretrained DiT and how every model is evaluated. • Appendix D reports per-dimension VBench scores, results at a higher resolution, and a human evaluation. • Appendix E ablates the autoencoder design and the alignment design. • Appendix F analyzes the compressed latent and the convergence of each of its parts, and Appendix G reports the training and inference cost. • Appendix H extends the discussion of related work, Appendix I collects the qualitative samples referenced throughout the paper, and Appendix J states the limitations of our method.
blocks.zh: 本附录提供补充材料,支持主要文件。 • 附录 A描述了我们自动编码器的架构和培训设置,附录B提供了DiT的相应细节,包括它如何被延伸至被压缩的潜伏. • 附录 C描述了比较的自编码器如何被调整到被预先训练的DiT上,以及每个模型如何被评价. • 附录D报告每分V Bench的分数,结果更高,以及人的评价。 • 附录E放弃了自动编码器设计和对接设计。 • 附录 F分析了每个部分的压缩潜力和趋同性,附录G报告了培训和推论费用。 • 附录 H 扩展了对相关工作的讨论,附录一收集了整个文件中提到的质量样本,附录J说明了我们方法的局限性。

blocks.en: A.1 Architectural Details
blocks.zh: A.1 建筑细节

blocks.en: Figure A.1: Detailed autoencoder architecture. ℰ res \mathcal{E}_{\text{res}} adds a downsampling stage between its middle blocks and head, consisting of residual blocks and a strided causal convolution, paired with a parameter-free shortcut that folds space and time into channels.
blocks.zh: 图A.1:详细自动化编码器架构. E res\ mathcal{E}_{\text{res}}}在它的中块和头之间添加了下采样阶段,由剩余块和被扭曲的因果演化组成,并配有将空间和时间折叠为通道的参数无快捷键.

blocks.en: Fig. A.1 shows the architecture of our autoencoder in detail. We reuse the encoder and decoder backbones of Wan2.1 and describe our additions below.
blocks.zh: 图A.1详细显示了我们的自动编码器的结构。 我们重用Wan2.1的编码器和解码器骨干,并在下面描述我们的添加.

blocks.en: Base encoding. We obtain 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} from the frozen encoder ℰ \mathcal{E} . Since ℰ \mathcal{E} compresses at fixed factors, we reduce the video first. We downsample the frames by r s r_{s} with bilinear interpolation, and subsample them by r t r_{t} in time. We experiment with average pooling, strided sampling, and bilinear interpolation as reduction strategies, and the setting above reconstructs best.
blocks.zh: 基础编码. 我们从被冻结的编码器 E\ mathcal{E} 获得 z 碱基 \ mathbf{z}_{\text{ base} 。 自兹 E\mathcal{E}在固定因素下压缩,我们先减少视频. 我们用双线插图对框架进行下标,然后用r tr_{t来分标。 我们用平均集合、分层采样和双线插图作为减少战略进行试验,上面的设置最能重建。

blocks.en: Residual encoding. The residual encoder ℰ res \mathcal{E}_{\text{res}} has the same architecture as ℰ \mathcal{E} , but takes the full-resolution video, so it needs an additional compression step to match the target resolution. In the pretrained encoder, four downsampling stages are followed by middle blocks that refine the feature at the final resolution through residual and attention layers, and then by a head that projects it to the latent. We add one downsample block between the middle blocks and the head. The block reuses the design of the pretrained downsample blocks, which pass the feature through two residual blocks before a strided convolution over space and a strided causal convolution over time. We attach a non-parametric shortcut to this block, following the residual autoencoding of DC-AE ( Chen et al., 2025a ) . Since the block compresses time as well as space, the shortcut moves both axes into the channel axis, then averages channel groups to match the channel number of the block output. Its result is added to the block output, which leaves the block to learn the residual.
blocks.zh: 残留编码. 残存的编码器E res\mathcal{E}_{\text{res}}有与E\mathcal{E}相同的架构,但取下全分辨率视频,因此需要额外的压缩步骤来匹配目标分辨率. 在预试编码器中,后有四个下采样阶段,中间块会通过残余和注意力层来细化最终解析时的特征,再由一个将特征投射到潜伏层的头. 在中间的街区和头部之间加一个下样品块. 区块再用预受训练的下采样区块的设计,通过两个剩余区块将特性传递到空间上,再经过一段时间后再进行分解的因果演化. 在DC-AE(Chen等,2025年a)的剩余自动编码之后,我们在此区块上附加了一个非参数快捷键。 由于块既压缩了时间又压缩了空间,快捷键将两个轴都移动到信道轴上,然后平均将信道组与块输出的信道号相匹配. 其结果被添加到块输出中,从而让块去学习残基.

blocks.en: Decoding. The decoder 𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}} extends the input convolution of 𝒟 \mathcal{D} from C C to C + C ′ C{+}C^{\prime} channels for the concatenated latent, and adds one upsample block symmetric to the downsample block of ℰ res \mathcal{E}_{\text{res}} . The weights for the residual channels are zero-initialized, so training starts at the pretrained reconstruction quality. The non-parametric shortcut of this block runs in the opposite direction, duplicating channels and then applying a channel-to-space-and-time operation. In the image-to-video setting, the first frame is available at inference as well as during training, and we pass it to 𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}} to restore detail the compressed latent cannot carry on its own. We encode the first frame with ℰ res \mathcal{E}_{\text{res}} and inject its intermediate features into 𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}} through gated cross-attention ( Tian et al., 2025 ) . We take the feature before each downsampling stage of the encoder and attend to it at the matching stage of 𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}} . A learned gate on each block controls how much of the first frame reaches 𝒟 ^ \hat{\mathcal{D}} .
blocks.zh: 解码. 解码器 D ^\ hat\ mathcal{D}}将 D \ mathcal{D} 的输入进化由 C 延伸至 C + C + C + C + C + C + C + prime} 通通通通通通的通道, 并在 E res\ mathcal{ E}_{\text{res} 的下行区块上加一个上行区块对称 。 剩余通道的权重为零初始化,因此训练从预训重建质量开始. 此块的非参数快捷键向相反方向运行,重复频道,然后应用通道到时空操作. 在图像到视频的设定中,第一帧既可以在推论中,也可以在训练中提供,我们把它传给了D^ ^\hat\mathcal{D}以恢复细节,压缩后潜力无法自行进行. 我们用 E res\ mathcal{E}_{\text{res} 编码了第一个框架,并通过有门的交叉注意(Tian等人,2025年)将其中间特征注入 D^\hat\mathcal{D}} 。 我们在编码器的每个下标阶段前,先取这个特征,然后在 D^\hat\mathcal{D}的相配阶段处理. 每个区块上都有一个有学识的门,控制了第一个框架有多少到达了 D^\hat\mathcal{D}} 。

blocks.en: Single-latent baseline. The baseline replaces the base and residual pair with a single encoder, so there is no frozen ℰ \mathcal{E} and no reduction of the input. The compression block keeps the same design and placement, and both the non-parametric shortcut and the first-frame cross-attention are unchanged.
blocks.zh: 单向基线。 基线用一个单一的编码器来取代碱基和剩余配对,因此没有被冻结的 E\ mathcal{E} 并且没有减少输入. 压缩块保持了相同的设计和布置,而非参数快捷键和第一帧交叉意向均保持不变.

blocks.en: B GRACE Diffusion Model Details
blocks.zh: B GRACE 扩散模型细节

blocks.en: B.1 Architectural Details
blocks.zh: B.1 建筑细节

blocks.en: We reuse the Wan2.1 DiT and modify only what the compressed latent requires.
blocks.zh: 我们重新使用Wan2.1 DiT 并且只修改压缩后的潜在要求。

blocks.en: Input and output projections. Wan2.1-14B patchifies a latent of C C channels, and for image-to-video it also takes a mask and the latent of the conditioning frame. We extend all three along the channel axis. The mask width is tied to the temporal compression factor, so it doubles with the latent, and we copy the pretrained weights into the channels it had before and zero-initialize the rest. The output projection is widened the same way, with the added channels zero-initialized, so the model starts from its pretrained behavior.
blocks.zh: 投入和产出预测。 湾2.1-14 B修复了C通道的潜伏,对于图像到视频来说,它还需要一个口罩和调节框架的潜伏. 我们沿着航道轴线延伸三道 口罩宽度与时间压缩因子相接,因此与潜入因子相接而成双倍相接,我们把预受训练的重量复制到它之前拥有的通道中去,再将其余部分零初始化. 输出投影也以同样的方式被拓宽了,所添加的频道为0-初始化,因此模型从被预先训练出的行为开始.

blocks.en: Position encoding. Compression places tokens farther apart in the video than the DiT was trained to expect. We therefore scale the RoPE ( Su et al., 2023 ) indices by r s r_{s} in space and r t r_{t} in time. This restores the token spacing the DiT was pretrained with.
blocks.zh: 位置编码 。 压缩在视频中放出比DiT训练时预期的更相去甚远的符号. 因此,我们在空间和r t r r rt 中将ROPE(Su等,2023年)指数按r s r r r r s 以时间缩放。 这恢复了预训的 DiT 的符号间隔 。

blocks.en: Timestep conditioning. The base and the residual latents are denoised at different noise levels, so the DiT receives two timesteps. For the transformer blocks, we add a second modulation projection W mod res W_{\text{mod}}^{\text{res}} for the residual timestep, and the two modulations are summed. The two output heads are conditioned separately, each on its own timestep.
blocks.zh: 时间节奏。 碱基和残余的潜质在不同噪声级别被去除,因此DiT得到两个时序. 对于变压器区块,我们为剩余时间档添加了第二个调制投影W mod res W_{\text{mod}}^{\text{res}}},两个调制被归纳. 两个出品头分别设置了条件,每个出品头按自己的时间步.

blocks.en: Single-latent baseline. The baseline extends the input and output projections in the same way, but the latent is not split, so one timestep suffices and W mod res W_{\text{mod}}^{\text{res}} is not added.
blocks.zh: 单向基线。 基线以同样方式延长了输入和输出预测,但潜伏部分并没有被分割,因此一个时间步就足够了,W mod res W_{\text{mod}}^{\text{res}}}没有被添加.

blocks.en: B.2 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: B.2 执行细节

blocks.en: We adapt the pretrained DiT to the compressed latent while the autoencoder stays frozen. Before the latent enters the DiT, we standardize each part with statistics measured on the training set, following the pretrained pipeline. We fully fine-tune the input projection, the output heads, and W mod res W_{\text{mod}}^{\text{res}} , together with the modulation and normalization parameters of each block. LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) is applied to all linear layers in the attention and feed-forward blocks, as well as to the key and value projections of the image cross-attention for image-to-video.
blocks.zh: 在自动编码器被冻结时,我们把预先训练的DiT适应压缩后的潜在。 在潜入DiT之前,我们把每个部分标准化,在经过预先训练的管道之后,用在培训组上测量的统计数据。 我们完全微调输入投影,输出头,和 W mod restext{mod}}^{\text{res},以及每个块的调制和常态参数. LoRA (Hu等,2021年)被应用于关注区和向导区块中的所有线性地层,并应用于图像对视频的图像交叉意向的关键和值预测.

blocks.en: Table B.1: Stage 2 hyperparameters. Offset and shift are sampled from a range in training, fixed at inference.
blocks.zh: 表B.1:第2阶段超参数。 抵消和转移从一系列训练中抽取,按推断确定。

blocks.en: Training setup. We train on Panda-70M ( Chen et al., 2024 ) at 480 × 832 × 81 480{\times}832{\times}81 with AdamW, using the hyperparameters in Tab. B.1 . We apply the standard video preprocessing, filtering out clips with scene cuts or excessive motion, and rewrite the captions with GPT-4o ( OpenAI et al., 2024 ) so that they match the length and detail of the prompts Wan2.1-14B was trained on. Text conditioning is dropped with probability 0.1 0.1 for classifier-free guidance.

blocks.en: C.1 Adaptation of Other Autoencoders
blocks.zh: C.1 其他自动编码器的改造

blocks.en: This section details how the pretrained DiT is adapted to each compared autoencoder in Tab. 1 . Our own autoencoder is adapted as described in Section 4.3 , which extends the pretrained input and output projections and denoises the base ahead of the residual. Both steps build on the base latent from the frozen Wan2.1 encoder, which is unavailable to the compared autoencoders, as their latent spaces are entirely different from the one the DiT was trained on. For each of them, we therefore adapt Wan2.1-I2V-14B with the released implementation of DC-Gen ( He et al., 2026 ) , a recent method that adapts a pretrained DiT to a new latent space in three stages: first the patch embedding, then the input and output layers, and finally the whole transformer with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) . Each autoencoder keeps the patch size of 1 used in its original generation model. This adaptation uses the same total budget of 38.5 H200 GPU days as our full pipeline, and all other settings are shared.
blocks.zh: 本节详细介绍了预训的DiT如何适应Tab中每个比较自编码器. 1. 如第4.3节所描述的那样,我们自己的自动编码器进行了调整,延长了事先经过训练的投入和产出预测,使基数高于剩余部分。 这两种步骤都建立在被冻结的Wan2.1编码器的底蕴上,而相对的自动编码器没有这种底蕴,因为它们的潜在空间与DiT所培训的编码完全不同。 因此,我们针对其中的每一个,将Wan2.1-I2V-14B与DC-Gen(He等,2026年)的放出执行相适应,这个最新方法将预先训练的DiT在三个阶段适应一个新的潜入空间:先是补丁嵌入,再是输入层和输出层,最后是整个变压器与LORA(Hu等,2021年). 每个自定义编码器都保留了原生成模型中使用的1的补丁大小. 这一适应使用的总预算为38.5个H200 GPU日,与我们的全部管道相同,所有其他设置都共享。

blocks.en: Autoencoder comparison. In Tab. 1 , we use Step-Video-VAE v2 ( Ma et al., 2025 ) , the Video DC-AE of Open-Sora 2.0 ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , and LTX-VAE 0.9.7 ( HaCohen et al., 2024 ) , whose 13B release is closest in size to the generation backbone we compare against. Video DC-AE is evaluated with the spatial and temporal tiling of its released implementation, which uses spatial tiles of 256 pixels and temporal tiles of 32 frames with an overlap factor of 0.25, and reconstructs better than the untiled variant.
blocks.zh: 自动编码器比较. 在Tab. 1中,我们使用Step-Video-VAE v2(Ma等,2025年),Open-Sora 2.0的视频DC-AE(郑等,2026年)和LTX-VAE 0.9.7(HaCohen等,2024年),其13B发布量最接近于我们比较的一代骨干. Video DC-AE以其所发布的执行的空间和时间平面来评价,它使用256像素的空间平面和32帧的时地平面,重叠系数为0.25,并且重建的优于成形变体.

blocks.en: Generation comparison. Every model adapted from Wan2.1, including ours, the single-latent baseline, and the latents in Tab. 1 , is sampled with a guidance scale of 5.0 and a flow shift of 3.0 on the full prompt and conditioning image set of VBench-I2V ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) . The other generators in Tab. 2 are run from their released checkpoints, the 13B development release of LTX-Video 0.9.7, the high-compression Video DC-AE release of Open-Sora 2.0, and the released DC-Gen model ( He et al., 2026 ) . We run LTX-Video as a single 50-step pass at the target resolution, without its multiscale pipeline and spatial upscaler, so that every model denoises the same number of steps at the same resolution. For text-to-video, each model is run with the prompt pipeline recommended by its authors: Wan2.1-14B, GRACE, and DC-Gen each use GPT-enhanced prompts from the VBench release, LTX-Video uses its built-in prompt enhancer, and Open-Sora 2.0 follows its default text-to-image-to-video path without prompt refinement. For image-to-video, VBench-I2V provides only short prompts. We expand them once with GPT-4o ( OpenAI et al., 2024 ) and use the same expanded set for Wan2.1-14B, GRACE, and Open-Sora 2.0, which do not release prompts for this setting. DC-Gen uses the extended prompts released with it, and LTX-Video uses its built-in prompt enhancer. Every model takes 50 sampling steps, but the number of forward passes through the DiT differs. LTX-Video combines classifier-free guidance with spatio-temporal guidance, and Open-Sora 2.0 guides on text and image separately, so both evaluate the DiT three times per step rather than twice. Latency covers the conditioning encode, the denoising loop, and the decode of the output video, measured on a single NVIDIA A100 SXM4-80GB in PyTorch with bfloat16 and no inference-time compilation. It excludes model loading, text encoding, and writing the decoded frames to an MP4 file, none of which depend on the latent resolution.

blocks.en: Latent uniformity. Following VA-VAE ( Yao et al., 2025 ) , we measure how evenly the latent tokens are distributed. We encode 10,000 10{,}000 clips at 256 × 256 × 81 256{\times}256{\times}81 , each from a distinct source video in the Panda-70M ( Chen et al., 2024 ) training split, and keep one token per clip, sampled at a random spatio-temporal position. Every autoencoder is probed at the same clips and positions. The tokens are standardized per channel and embedded with t-SNE ( van der Maaten and Hinton, 2008 ) at a perplexity of 30 30 , and we report the coefficient of variation, Gini coefficient, and normalized entropy of a Gaussian kernel density estimate on the embedding, averaged over two t-SNE seeds.

blocks.en: C.3 Alignment to V-JEPA 2.1
blocks.zh: C.3 与V-JEPA保持一致

blocks.en: For Tab. 5 , we use the frozen V-JEPA 2.1 ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) ViT-L encoder at 256 × 256 256{\times}256 , whose 16 × 16 16{\times}16 patch grid already matches the spatial grid of our f16 latent, so no spatial interpolation is needed. Since V-JEPA 2.1 is trained on clips of up to 64 frames, we apply the alignment to the first 65 frames of each 81-frame training clip. Our causal latent encodes the first frame on its own, so we encode it with V-JEPA 2.1 separately and align it with the first latent frame. Each remaining latent frame covers 8 frames and corresponds to four V-JEPA 2.1 tokens of 2 frames each, so a learnable transposed 3D convolution upsamples these latent frames 4 × 4\times in time to match. We align to the features of block 23, the final block of the encoder, whose output V-JEPA 2.1 uses directly for dense downstream tasks ( Mur-Labadia et al., 2026 ) . The alignment uses the same per-token cosine loss and adaptive weighting as ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\text{align}} .
blocks.zh: 对于Tab. 5,我们使用被冻结的V-JEPA 2.1(Mur-Labadia等,2026年) VIT-L编码器在256×256\256\times}256,其16×16\16\times}16的补丁网格已经与我们f16潜伏的空间网格相匹配,因此不需要空间插值. 由于V-JEPA 2.1接受最多64个帧的剪辑培训,我们对每个81个帧的剪辑中的前65个帧进行了调整。 我们的因果潜伏编码了第一个框架,所以我们用V-JEPA 2.1单独编码,并与第一个潜伏框架相配合. 每个剩余的潜在框架覆盖了8个框架,并对应4个V-JEPA 2.1个令牌,每个2个框架,所以一个可学习的可移植的3D分解可以对这些潜在框架4×4\时间进行样本以及时匹配. 我们与编码器最后区块第23项的特征保持一致,其产出V-JEPA 2.1直接用于密集下游任务(Mur-Labadia等,2026年)。 校正使用与 L 校正 & mathcal{L}_{\text{ align{} 相同的每盘余弦减值和适应性加权.

blocks.en: Aesthetic quality. DC-Gen scores above GRACE on this dimension in T2V settings, while scoring below on every total. We observe that its samples are consistently more saturated than those of the pretrained pipeline (Figs. I.1 – I.4 ), and the LAION aesthetic predictor behind this dimension has been shown to track photographic taste rather than fidelity to the prompt or to the conditioning image ( Taylor et al., 2026 ) . The dimension therefore rewards a shift in appearance that the other dimensions penalize.
blocks.zh: 美学素质. DC-Gen在T2V设置中在这个维度上得分高于GRACE,而在下面则在每个总分上得分. 我们观察到,其样品的饱和度一直高于预先训练过的管道(图一.1-一.4),而且这一维度背后的LAION美学预测器已被显示用于跟踪摄影品味,而不是对即时或调制图像的忠诚度(Taylor等,2026年)。 因此,这一层面有利于外观的转变,而其他层面则会受到惩罚。

It runs an extra guidance branch for temporal consistency, and in the image-to-video setting it also moves the least of all compared models, with a dynamic degree of 24.80 against 38.62 for GRACE. Videos that move less tend to score higher on these dimensions ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) , and the same holds at 736 × 1280 736{\times}1280 , where GRACE moves less than LTX-Video (30.89 against 49.59) and leads on background consistency and temporal flickering instead.

blocks.en:
We conduct a blind user study comparing our method with Wan2.1-14B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) and the adaptation-based DC-Gen ( He et al., 2026 ) in both the T2V and I2V settings, using 40 prompts randomly selected per setting from VBench ( Huang et al., 2023 ; Huang et al., 2024 ) (with their conditioning images for I2V).
Each model uses its own prompt extension; participants see the original VBench prompt.
Participants view two videos generated from the same prompt, ours and one baseline, in randomized A/B order, and judge which is better in
visual quality (fewer unnatural colors or shapes and a better overall appearance),
temporal consistency (no flicker, stutter, or objects changing over time), and
text alignment (the subjects, actions, details, and style described in the prompt), with an “about equal” option for each.
39 human raters each rated 16 pairs, eight per setting, so each of the 160 comparison pairs is rated by at least 3 different participants, giving 156 votes per setting, baseline, and criterion.
Tab. D.3 reports the win, tie, and loss rates of our method.

blocks.en: As plotted in Fig. F.1 (a), both PSNR and LPIPS degrade steadily for either latent under noise, and faster for 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} across the whole range. Fig. F.1 (b) also shows that both 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} and 𝐳 res \mathbf{z}_{\text{res}} fail in different ways, with 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} breaking the spatial layout of the scene while 𝐳 res \mathbf{z}_{\text{res}} keeps the layout and instead blurs each frame and makes the motion appear at a lower frame rate. A video built from 𝐳 base \mathbf{z}_{\text{base}} alone would show blurred frames and motion that steps between the sampled frames rather than flowing through them, precisely what 𝐳 res \mathbf{z}_{\text{res}} was trained to restore.

blocks.en: H More Discussion on Related Work
blocks.zh: H 关于相关工作的进一步讨论

blocks.en: Improving the latent space for generation. Beyond compression, several works improve the latent space itself so that the diffusion model learns it more easily ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025c ; Wu et al., 2024 ) . These works mostly train the generation model from scratch on the resulting latent, whereas we shape the latent so that an already trained model can be reused.
blocks.zh: 改善潜在的发电空间。 除了压缩之外,一些作品还改进了潜在空间本身,使扩散模型更容易地学习(郑等,2025;陈等,2025c;吴等,2024.). 这些工程主要是从零开始将生成模型从产生的潜伏中训练出来,而我们则塑造了潜伏中,这样已经经过训练的模型就可以被再利用。

blocks.en: Efficient video autoencoder architectures. Compared to images, video carries an additional temporal dimension, which makes the autoencoder both harder to design and more expensive to run. Wavelet-based designs reduce this cost by replacing part of the convolutional stack with a fixed multi-resolution transform ( Li et al., 2025 ; Cheng and Yuan, 2025 ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ) . These reduce the cost of the autoencoder itself rather than the token count the diffusion model processes.
blocks.zh: 高效的视频自动编码器架构. 相较于图像,视频带有额外的时间维度,这使得自动编码器既难以设计,也更昂贵地运行. 以Wablet为主的设计通过用固定多分辨率变换来取代部分相接堆来降低这一成本(Li等,2025;程和元等,2025;NVIDIA等,2025.). 这些降低了自编码器本身的成本,而不是象征性地计算出扩散模型的过程.

blocks.en: J Limitations
blocks.zh: J 限制

blocks.en: Compressing the latent leaves fewer tokens for each frame, and small objects suffer the most. Distant faces, text on signs, and thin structures are often lost or broken, while the overall scene and its motion stay intact. The effect shows in Figs. I.3 and I.4 , and it is weaker at 736 × 1280 736{\times}1280 , where the same compression ratio leaves more tokens per frame. GRACE-VAE is also optimized for the DiT rather than for reconstruction alone, and trades some reconstruction fidelity for generation quality. At the same token count, its PSNR is 1.13 dB below our single-latent baseline (Tab. 1 ). Adding more residual channels could recover more of this detail, but adapting a pretrained DiT to a higher-dimensional latent is itself difficult ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , and we leave this to future work.

blocks.en: Applying GRACE to a new pretrained pipeline also requires training a new autoencoder, since the base latent comes from that pipeline’s frozen encoder and ℒ align \mathcal{L}_{\text{align}} is supervised by its DiT. Each new pipeline therefore costs one more Stage 1 run, 8.5 H200 GPU days in our setting.
